thread.title: Apple stock gains after Canaccord boosts target to $250 on 'resilient iPhone sales'

author: morningstar.com
title: Apple stock gains after Canaccord boosts target to $250 on 'resilient iPhone sales'
text:
Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) are up 0.2% in premarket trading Tuesday after Canaccord Genuity analyst Michael Walkley upped his price target to $250 from $220. He wrote that his survey work indicates "resilient iPhone sales" even though the most recent iPhone models are close to a year old. He believes that Apple's next line, which is expected to feature three new products, will "help drive a continued strong upgrade cycle to higher margin and higher ASP iPhones." ASP refers to the average selling price of devices. Walkley is also optimistic about what the iPhone sales traction means for Apple's recurring revenue stream. "Steady iPhone sales to growing premium tier installed base supports strong long-term services revenue growth," he wrote. Apple shares are up 39% over the past 12 months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average has gained 18%.
